caption: The drawing depicts three distinct metal tools or instruments laid out horizontally and parallel to each other on a plain, cream-colored background. The first two objects at the top appear similar in shape, both having a flat, spatula-like blade that broadens and then narrows into a thinner handle, with a slight bulge in the middle, and detailed shading that suggests a shiny metallic surface. Below these, the third object is a long, slender, and slightly bent rod that tapers off at the ends and has a single pronounced angular bend near one tip. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale, using shades of grey and black with careful shading to suggest form and light reflection. The artist's signature and the date "J.R. TOWERS DEL. 73" are written in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Salt Spoon
